standing: Closed Draft 2020-12 records for docs/v2/contracts/product-v1/security-and-lifecycle.md. Validated with the foundation exact validator (exact integer/const/enum types). Records marked `metadata` are signed security metadata under opensip-metadata-canonical.1 (NFC strings, i64 integers); every other record is product data under foundation/canonical.py. Design evidence, not a product implementation. Version 2 adds RootV1/RootV2 (schema-2 extension recipe), the profile-set envelope, the boot-bound pending challenge, RepoExecutionGrantV2, RepairApplyAuthorizationV1, StorageWriteAdmissionV1 and discovery unit kinds. Post-reset v2 additions: AdmittedBoundaryInventoryV1 (S3 export, P3), RepairRecoveryAuthorizationV1 / RecoveryAuthorizationAdmissionV1 (S10.2, P9), InstallationTransitionIntentV1 / InstallationTransitionJournalV1 / TransitionIntentAdmissionV1 / TransitionJournalAdmissionV1 / TransitionRecoveryV1 (S9.2, P10) and the LeaseTraceV1 transition-journal op.

recordSchema.description: Current product grant-journal record format. Bundle filename security-lifecycle.schemas.v1.json is not this version. Schema-2 journals are frozen historical bytes under JournalRecordV2 and are not read as 3.

runId.description: Current analysis Run identity. SEAL records that name a Run use run3. No run[23] alternation. Historical schema-2 journals that recorded run2 remain those bytes.

JournalRecordV2.description: FROZEN historical grant-journal record (recordSchema 2, run2). Not the current selected schema. Not an alternative parser for recordSchema 3. Used only to identify historical bytes so they are refused as current rather than relabelled.

PrunedTreeRowV2.description: Pruned-tree row VERSION 2 (XA-02 / CR-25). Closed four-member row. The anchor is known from the admitted directory observation and is recorded even when no descendant marker was observed; discovery never descends into the tree to obtain a count or to find a nested anchor. markerCount is null if and only if markerCountBasis is not-enumerated. Version-1 rows keep their bytes under the version-1 records and are read as version 1, never re-read as version 2.

markerCount.description: Exact count of distinct supplied marker paths under this anchor when markerCountBasis is observed-inventory; null when not-enumerated. Common i64 nonnegative domain, shared byte-for-byte with the native mirror.

markerCountBasis.description: Whether the SUPPLIED marker inventory enumerated inside this pruned tree. not-enumerated means discovery did not descend, or the anchor own directory observation could not be established, and markerCount is null. observed-inventory means markerCount is exact OVER THE SUPPLIED INVENTORY ONLY; zero observed never means zero hidden. Provenance only: never a comparison key, never a unit-selection, work-bound, Coverage or scope input.

TrustClockRecordV1.title: SC-TRUST clock and floor fields (state, host-private; not signed metadata)

TrustRecoveryChallengeV1.title: metadata: exported by `opensip trust recovery-challenge`; digest domain opensip.metadata.recovery-challenge.1

TrustRecoveryEpochV1.title: metadata: signed body under opensip-signature-envelope.2 kind `trust-recovery-epoch` (digest domain opensip.metadata.recovery-epoch.1); signers = accepted root's recoveryAuthority.keys at recoveryAuthority.threshold; counters must EQUAL the challenged record's counters

nestedProjects.description: directories under the selected root that hold their own opensip.json: deliberate project boundaries (ADV-3), recorded and never entered; reachable only by their own launch or --project

prunedTrees.description: anchors of dependency (node_modules), VCS (.git/.hg/.svn/.jj) and Cargo build-output (target directly under a Cargo.toml directory) trees observed under the selected root; pruned by exact path segment per ../discovery-defaults.py; one record per tree, never per package

HostSealRunAdmissionV1.description: Output of admit_seal_run_id_prefix. Pattern dispatch only. Not close_run.

AnalysisSealAdmissionV1.description: Output of admit_analysis_seal after identity-model.v3.close_run and RunId comparison. Not linearize.

PlatformProfileSetV1.title: metadata: signed release profile population keyed by the ONE machine platform vocabulary (linux-aarch64-gnu, linux-x86_64-gnu, macos-aarch64, macos-x86_64; the same ids as RepoExecutionGrantV2.platformId, the native matrix platformFamilies and the workflow test-execution schema); display aliases (macos-arm64, linux-x86_64, linux-arm64) never key it; per platform: measured lanes + supported baseline; values in fixtures are SYNTHETIC

platform.description: the observed platform id as presented; on ADMIT always one of the four machine ids

displayAlias.description: human display alias of an admitted machine id (macos-arm64, macos-x86_64, linux-x86_64, linux-arm64); null when the presented platform is not a machine id; never an input

RepoExecutionGrantV1.title: SUPERSEDED by RepoExecutionGrantV2 (never accepted; admitted by nothing). Retained so the superseded selector is byte-visible.

RootV1.title: metadata: root schema 1 = security-schemas.v8/root.schema.json rule set, preserved unchanged (TR-REPAIR typed absence, kernelAttestationKeys exactly []); semantic rules in admit_root_document

RootV2.title: metadata: root schema 2 = byte-exact extension of schema 1: rootSchema const 2; roles gains required TR-PROFILE (signs platform-profile-set); TR-REPAIR and TR-PROFILE may be active (threshold >= 2, keys >= threshold+1, namespaces non-empty; no reuse of rootKeys/recoveryAuthority/other role keys); kernelAttestationKeys 0..8 Hex64 (no reuse). Everything else identical to RootV1. Digest domain opensip.metadata.root.2; signed by previous rootKeys@rootThreshold AND own rootKeys@rootThreshold

PlatformProfileSetEnvelopeV1.title: metadata: opensip-signature-envelope.2 binding for kind platform-profile-set; bodyDigest = metadata digest domain opensip.metadata.platform-profile-set.1 over the canonical body; signers (asserted, outside this record) must reach the schema-2 root's TR-PROFILE threshold

RepoExecutionGrantV2.title: product data; identity H('security.repo-execution-grant.v2', grant) is the workflow `securityGrantRef`/`authorizationRef` for test execution and the native AuthorizedExecutionV2 authorization; distinct from the foundation semanticGrantDigest

RepairApplyAuthorizationV1.title: product data; identity H('security.repair-apply-authorization.v1', record) is the workflow RepairApplyParams.authorizationRef; authorizes brokered first-party source mutation under EXCLUSIVE lease, never repository execution

CoreTransitionScopeV1.title: S7 core-transition lease set decided from the intent and the host namespace registry (never user input)

SemanticProjectionV1.title: S10 principals a consuming analysis must project into plan2 for the preparation grants it consumes (test-runner grants project nothing)

ExecutionProjectionAdmissionV1.title: S10 Plan-time join: plan2 semantic-grant projection versus the consumed preparation grants; never derived from a grant

AdmittedBoundaryInventoryV1.title: S3 export (post-reset v2 P3): the admitted authority boundaries of the selected root as relative scope paths; produced only by boundary_inventory over an ACCEPTed DiscoveryResultV1 and consumed unchanged by the native unit instrument

RepairRecoveryAuthorizationV1.title: product data (S10.2); identity H('security.repair-recovery-authorization.v1', record) is the workflow RepairApplyJournalV1.recoveryAuthorizationRef; authorizes ONE finite recovery action within the original plan's authority under the EXCLUSIVE lease at the host-broker boundary; never repository execution, never a new edit

journalRef.description: H over the closed noncircular journal identity preimage {schemaFamily, schemaMajor, requestId, stepId, executionId, repairPlanId, baseSnapshotId, authorizationRef}: never state, paths, blobs or a recoveryAuthorizationRef

observedJournalStateDigest.description: raw SHA-256 of canonical {state, stagedPaths, appliedPaths, preimageBlobs} as read under the EXCLUSIVE lease before any recovery write; single use / crash-safe resume

InstallationTransitionIntentV1.title: S9.2 required operation/field contract of the host-projected installation transition intent (workflow CoreTransitionIntentV1 successor; the same eleven fields serve core update|repair|rollback and store migrate|rollback)

InstallationTransitionJournalV1.title: S9.2 closed installation transition journal, written under the held fence only after every lease of the affected set is held; identity H('security.installation-transition-journal.v1', record)

intentDigest.description: raw SHA-256 of the canonical admitted intent (= the mutation step inputDescriptorDigest, S15)

registryDigest.description: raw SHA-256 of the canonical sorted namespace registry frozen under the fence

leaseSet.description: the exact EXCLUSIVE lease set held (locator byte order) = core_transition_affected_namespaces over the frozen registry

TransitionRecoveryV1.title: S9.2 crash recovery decision for a journaled installation transition (first act under the next fence)

PublicDetailProjectionV1.title: S12 projection of a security outcome onto the ONE closed public DomainDetail vocabulary. `items` are the {code, subject, d9} triples a host emits; `code` is always a member of SECURITY_PUBLIC_DETAIL_CODES; `subject` is free bounded text and never a second vocabulary. `pendingRegistrationCodes` lists members the shared public-detail registry does not yet carry.

nestedProjects.description: directories under the selected root that hold their own opensip.json: deliberate project boundaries (ADV-3), recorded and never entered; reachable only by their own launch or --project

prunedTrees.description: anchors of dependency (node_modules), VCS (.git/.hg/.svn/.jj) and Cargo build-output (target directly under a Cargo.toml directory) trees observed under the selected root; pruned by exact path segment per ../discovery-defaults.py; one record per tree, never per package. VERSION 2 (CR-25): an anchor observed as a directory entry is recorded even with zero observed descendant markers, and the count carries an explicit basis.

AdmittedBoundaryInventoryV2.title: S3 export (post-reset v2 P3): the admitted authority boundaries of the selected root as relative scope paths; produced only by boundary_inventory over an ACCEPTed DiscoveryResultV1 and consumed unchanged by the native unit instrument

markerCountBasis.description: Whether the SUPPLIED marker inventory enumerated inside this pruned tree. not-enumerated means discovery did not descend, or the anchor own directory observation could not be established, and markerCount is null. observed-inventory means markerCount is exact OVER THE SUPPLIED INVENTORY ONLY; zero observed never means zero hidden. Provenance only: never a comparison key, never a unit-selection, work-bound, Coverage or scope input.

DiscoveryResultV2.description: Discovery result VERSION 2 (XA-02 / CR-25): identical shape to version 1 with a version-2 provenance record. Version 1 is retained as the historical result record for version-1 provenance bytes; an output is never validated under the version-1 name once its provenance changed.
